verdict.rationale: Calendly's first-party docs describe a Webhook API that sends payloads in real time to your endpoint when invitees schedule, cancel, or reschedule a meeting, by either host or invitee. Webhook signing keys are documented for verifying authenticity. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how reschedules appear in the payload (the guide only names scheduled/canceled events), and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.
